mcqs.question: According to the data on stroke burden in India, how many stroke deaths were recorded in 2019, and what share did they constitute of all deaths?
options: 6.99 lakh, constituting more than 60% of all deaths
mcqs.explanation: India recorded 6.99 lakh stroke deaths in 2019, accounting for 7.4% of all deaths. The figure of 1.8 million refers to new stroke cases per year, not deaths.
